rules.name: PhD Minor Requirements

children.name: All units in a single field
PhD minor form approved by the major and minor departments

rules.desc:
The minimum university requirement for a PhD minor is 20 units of History coursework at Stanford’s graduate level (courses numbered 300 and above). All units should be in a single field. Units taken for the minor can be counted as part of the overall requirement for the PhD of 135 units taken at Stanford. Courses used for a minor may not be used to meet the requirements for a master’s degree.
Degree Requirements
Twenty units of history coursework at the graduate level (HISTORY 300-399W and 400-499X) at Stanford. All units should be in a single field.
Optional Courses for the Minor
The major and minor departments must approve a PhD minor form outlining the program of study.

transferPolicy: Per policy, all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks 20 units of graduate HISTORY courses numbered 300 to 499, all taken at Stanford. Checked by hand: that all units are in a single field and that both departments approved the PhD minor form.
